127 likes, 4 comments - suyashkeshari on October 10, 2026: "This Wildlife Week, I’m sharing the story of the Godawan, the Great Indian Bustard, one of India’s most endangered birds. Found in the grasslands of Rajasthan, its survival depends on focused conservation efforts, habitat protection, and people coming together to safeguard its future.

A reminder that conservation is more than protecting a species; it’s about preserving the ecosystems they call home and ensuring that future generations get to witness their existence in the wild. 🤍

Watch the film and discover the journey of the Godawan.
@godawanexperiences

#DurbarEvenings #GodawanEstuaryPremiumWater #GodawanDurbar #GodawanExperiences".

3,181 likes, 43 comments - suyashkeshari on October 4, 2026: "Have you ever seen a tiger hugging a tree?🌳🐯 

This is a big male scratch marking a tree @ameliyasafaris 

This is a form of territorial marking and communication. 

Tigers have scent glands between their toes, so when they scratch, they leave behind both a visual message and their scent.

Other tigers can then pick up on these marks and scents, helping them understand who has been through the area and that the territory is occupied.

And the higher and more prominent the scratch marks, the harder they are to miss. It also signals dominance. 

So while we put up signs saying “Private Property”…

Tigers scratch a tree 🐅

Same message. Much better handwriting. 😜

#TigerSafariIndia #bandhavgarh #luxurysafari #indiansafari".

5,454 likes, 46 comments - suyashkeshari on October 2, 2026: "India is our home. 🧡 It’s not just about its tigers. 🐅

The wildlife and landscapes that still survive against all odds. 🌳

The culture woven through every village, city and forest. 🎨

The mountains that humble every traveller. 🏔️

It’s about the people who bring this country to life. 🙌🏻

The rivers that have carried our stories, sustained our lands. 🌊

The traditions we hold onto so deeply. 🪔

The history etched into our forts and temples. 🛕

The endless chorus of birds at sunrise. 🌅 

The warmth of our people, where a stranger is welcomed like family. 🙏🏻

The smallest lives that quietly hold our ecosystems together. 🦋

The contrast between ancient roots and changing times. ⏳

The India we protect today, so future generations can experience its wonder tomorrow. 🌏

The people who dedicate their lives to protecting what cannot speak for itself. 🌱

India is not just a destination. India is a feeling. 🇮🇳

Come experience it for yourself 

📩 Email: Reservations@AmeliyaSafaris.com".
